environment.isolation: Fresh Vercel sandbox with separate clean npm and Python consumer directories
environment.browser: Chromium 156.0.8078.4; Playwright video capture; same walkthrough observed in connected Chrome

steps.name: Check published npm versions
steps.command: npm view @tidelight/sdk@0.1.2 version && npm view @tidelight/mcp@0.1.2 version && npm view @tidelight/react@0.1.2 version && npm view @tidelight/cli@0.1.2 version

steps.name: Verify dependency tree, imports, and CLI
steps.command: cd /vercel/fresh-npm-consumer && npm ls --depth=0 && node --input-type=module -e 'for (const p of ["@tidelight/sdk","@tidelight/mcp","@tidelight/react"]) {const m=await import(p);console.log(p,"exports",Object.keys(m))}' && ./node_modules/.bin/tidelight --help
steps.result: All four dependencies present; SDK, MCP, and React ESM imports passed; CLI help rendered.

steps.name: Inspect all published npm package archives
steps.command: cd /vercel/fresh-npm-consumer && npm pack @tidelight/sdk@0.1.2 --dry-run && npm pack @tidelight/mcp@0.1.2 --dry-run && npm pack @tidelight/react@0.1.2 --dry-run && npm pack @tidelight/cli@0.1.2 --dry-run
steps.result: All four npm pack dry-runs completed.

steps.name: Create a fresh Python 3.12 environment
steps.command: mkdir -p /vercel/fresh-python-consumer && rm -rf /vercel/fresh-python-consumer/venv && python3.12 --version && python3.12 -m venv /vercel/fresh-python-consumer/venv && /vercel/fresh-python-consumer/venv/bin/python -m pip --version
steps.result: Python 3.12.14 and pip 23.2.1 in a newly recreated Python 3.12 virtual environment.

steps.name: Install Python client from PyPI
steps.result: PyPI wheel downloaded/cached and tidelight 0.1.2 installed. pip emitted a non-fatal latest-version check warning.

steps.name: Import Python client and inspect installed metadata
steps.command: /vercel/fresh-python-consumer/venv/bin/python -c 'import tidelight; from tidelight import Client; import inspect; print("Tidelight import: PASS"); print("Client signature:",inspect.signature(Client))' && /vercel/fresh-python-consumer/venv/bin/python -m pip show tidelight
steps.result: Import passed; Client signature and tidelight 0.1.2 metadata displayed.

steps.name: Review final dependency tree and npm audit
steps.result: All four npm packages present; zero vulnerabilities reported.
